# News Release


5/07/2026


SOUTH BOW ANNOUNCES APPROVAL OF RESOLUTIONS AT ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING OF SHAREHOLDERS


CALGARY, Alta. – May 7, 2026 – South Bow Corp. (TSX & NYSE: SOBO) (South Bow or the Company) announces that its shareholders approved all resolutions at the Company’s annual general meeting held on May 7, 2026 (the Meeting).
